name: crypto.rand
doc: Cryptographically secure random numbers from the operating system.

items.name: Bytes
items.doc: Bytes returns n cryptographically secure random bytes.
items.summary: Bytes returns n cryptographically secure random bytes.

items.name: Hex
items.doc: Hex returns n random bytes as 2n lowercase hex characters.
items.summary: Hex returns n random bytes as 2n lowercase hex characters.

items.name: Int
items.doc: Int returns a cryptographically secure random non-negative int.
items.summary: Int returns a cryptographically secure random non-negative int.
